description: SFLOW explicit (A 210 2, A 220 3) with dry land as a wall (A 221 2, A 209 0) on 2 ranks: regular waves (T 6 s, kh 1.3, 4 m cells) onto a breakwater of dry cells (T 10, 8 m thick, 2 m above the water) across half of the basin: walls of dry land in x (front and lee side) and in y (the tip), the corner cells of the tip with two walls, a rank boundary through the breakwater. Gauges in front of it (standing wave), at the tip and in the lee.
covers: sflow_drywall.h in 2D: walls in x and y, the diagonals of cliff
